items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: as Leroy and I did not arrive with the group

ctx.x: But our baggage, trunks and Arnold Boling's drum case

and Wilson Meyer's bass which was in a specially made trunk were not put on the launch. In fact they were still at the station in Nice when we boarded the bus to go to Villefranche. We found out the reason from the baggage commissary; the baggage had been sent from Paris in a collective group ticket and as Leroy and I did not arrive with the group, all the tickets were not available so the baggage could not be collected by those that had arrived before us and there was not enough time for it to be put aboard ship…
Two musicians were also missing. Booker Pittman and Alfred Pratt had decided to stay in France with their wives. Freddy Taylor also stayed.
